constraintAnalysis.scope: Geometric feasibility, not human fusion: exact RGB graph projection versus the original screen-space image. Endpoint conflicts compare source-center RGB demands (>16 byte levels in any channel). Threshold is descriptive, not a comfort gate.

dataset: City plaza walk and turn · reversed relief

preview.scope: Native stereo previews only. Inputs, diagnostic maps and filter workspaces consume additional memory. All frames are analyzed.

motion.scope: Screen changes include intended motion. Disparity jitter subtracts the change in intended disparity at each screen sample; this is not world-space optical flow.

colorSpread.scope: Response to a local source-color intervention with identical depth, not a perceptual ghost score.

findings.message: Large areas lack consistent, distinctive matching evidence. Inspect the unsupported-region map.
Strong nonharmonic matches exist outside the calibrated depth range.
Decoded depth changes exceed the intended changes by over two pixels RMS.
A local source-color edit propagates well beyond its stereo-pair neighborhood.
